serial.label: Wing closure owner (Freerouting hybrid)
serial.prompt: Close the 17 emulator signals of route report §D6 (EMU_BATT_SDA, EMU_CTL_FC_RESET, EMU_CTL_WDT_DIS, EMU_F1_SENSE, EMU_F2_SDA, EMU_F2_SENSE, EMU_F3_SCL, EMU_F3_SENSE, EMU_FC3V3_SENSE, EMU_GPIO_SPARE1, EMU_STATUS_LED, EMU_SWCLK, EMU_SWDIO, EMU_TOP_SCL, EMU_UART_TX, PYRO_INHIBIT_STATE, one 3V3_EMU branch) plus anything else the merge left open (except the U6.1/U6.29 baseline). PM METHOD (brief §12 F14b; §D8 says why a plain full-board Freerouting run fails: one global DSN clearance makes every 0.127 mm fan-out track a violation): (1) BREAKOUT: with micro.py (area-aware), carry each open signal from its escape via to a BREAKOUT VIA placed 0.3-1.5 mm OUTSIDE the EMU_FANOUT rectangle, at the netclass via size, on the layer the panel plan assigns (In2 for 3V3_EMU and PYRO_INHIBIT_STATE per F9; otherwise In2/B.Cu per panel_fix_plan routing_instructions); exact polygon check on every item. (2) ROUTE: on an EXPORT copy only, delete every track/via inside the EMU_FANOUT rectangle and add the rectangle as an all-layer keepout to YOUR OWN copy of fc_keepout.json (never edit the shared file); every other routed net is fixed copper; run tools/pcb/route.sh with KEEPOUT_JSON=<your copy>, REF_BOARD, PRUNE=1, FR_TIMEOUT_MIN=150, in the background with a Monitor. Freerouting then only routes breakout via -> destination hops. (3) MERGE the routed hops back onto the FULL board (with the ring intact) — route_merge adopts chains reaching a new-footprint pad; make sure chains that end on a breakout via are adopted too (adapt the merge in your scratch copy if needed). (4) Anything still open: finish by hand with micro.py/stitch.py; you may rip and redo GND items the gnd workstream placed if they block an exit, but they must end closed. Target: drc_unconnected = 1 (the U6.1/U6.29 baseline), heritage 0, attachment 0, DRC errors 0. If anything else remains, name it with the exact geometric reason and the smallest rule change that would close it. Then append a 'Closure stage, round 3' section (§E1...) to docs route_report.md: method, what closed per workstream (read the deploy2en/gnd/merge notes.md files named in the previous results and in the scratch dir), via counts, what remains. Write it in chunks of at most 60 lines.
